meta.entry_assumption: Block 1 peaks at 21 mi/wk with an 11 mi long run in week 10, then week 11 eases to 18 mi and week 12 deloads to 12 mi for the retest. Block 2 opens at 20.5 mi with a 9 mi long run - below the Block 1 peak on purpose - and builds over 7 build weeks to 29 mi and a 13 mi long run in week 19, then tapers four weeks into Dec 5. No build week grows more than 10% over the previous peak. If you arrive at week 13 short of 18 mi/wk or an 8 mi long run, repeat week 13 before advancing and accept a smaller peak.

meta.block3_entry: Block 3 opens at 22 mi with a 10 mi long run - below the Block 2 peak (29 mi, 13 mi long run) on purpose, two weeks after Peacock Gap. It builds in 3-up/1-down cycles to 34 mi and a 20 mi dress rehearsal in week 35, then tapers three weeks into the race. No build week grows more than 10% over the previous peak. If the half or the holidays leave you short of 18 mi/wk by week 25, repeat week 25 before advancing and drop the peak long run to 18 mi.
